name: PostgreSQL
summary: PostgreSQL pool as app.pg (app.pg.query(sql, params)). SQL files in migrations/ run in order at startup. Always use parameters ($1, $2).

features: - **PostgreSQL**: connection pool at `app.pg`; add SQL files to `migrations/` and they run automatically on startup

env.description: PostgreSQL connection string (set automatically when a database is attached in Morline)
